source_note: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题
english_source_note: Boundedness of Partial Sums of Highly Oscillatory Sequences
callout_id: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题#4
statement_en: Let $$P(n):=a_dn^d+a_{d-1}n^{d-1}+\cdots+a_1 n +a_0\in \mathbb{R}[n],\ d\geq 2,$$ be a polynomial of degree at least $2$ such that at least one of the coefficients $a_d,\ldots,a_2$ is irrational. Let $i\neq j\in \mathbb{Z}$ and $(m_1,m_2)\in \mathbb{Z}^2\setminus \{(0,0)\}$. Then $$Q(n):=m_1P(n+i)-m_2P(n+j)$$ is a nonconstant polynomial, and at least one of its nonconstant coefficients is irrational.
callout_body: 设$$P(n):=a_dn^d+a_{d-1}n^{d-1}+\cdots+a_1 n +a_0\in \mathbb{R}[n],d\geq 2$$是次数至少为2的，系数$a_d,\cdots,a_2$当中至少有一个系数为无理数的多项式。令$i\neq j\in \mathbb{Z}$，$(m_1,m_2)\in \mathbb{Z}^2\setminus \{(0,0)\}$则$$Q(n):=m_1P(n+i)-m_2P(n+j)$$是一个非常数多项式，并且它的非常数系数里至少有一个无理数。
